protocol.cohort: All 32 original synthetic training geometries, paired with their 32 printed and 32 scene variants. Every counterpart must retain exactly identical material labels.
protocol.objective: BCE on known fractional labels only, no phase exchange, Adam on free 160x160 logits; use exact production-head interpolation: bilinear align_corners=False, then sigmoid. Final update only.
protocol.reference: Known labels fit the logits directly; no photographs enter the optimizer. This exhibits a feasible output-grid representation, not a predictive model, certified optimum, lower bound or topology certificate.
protocol.comparison: Compare all three fixed synthetic groups to their stored parent and boundary-weighted material metrics. Report overall, boundary and interior errors; known-label denominators independent of predicted body. All fields saved; visually inspect the eight largest reference errors.
protocol.followup: Only if output-grid references are substantially cleaner than actual predictions should future work focus on learned identity evidence/context rather than increasing decoder resolution by default.
protocol.numerics: Optimize free logits in float64 to avoid saturated float32 Adam phase drift; cast the final grid to float32 and decode exactly as the head. Save both grids and probabilities for independent replay.
